label: wherewhen - Data Export
info:
PLAN.md §20 — backs up everything InfluxDB holds, so a wiped/migrated HA install isn't a total loss. Originally: manual trigger, plus a weekly schedule (Sunday 3am) so a usable backup exists even if Ward forgets to run one by hand.

Now ALSO callable (Aug 2026, full_sync_flow.json) via n_wde_link_in, as Full Sync's last step, and Full Sync runs nightly at 2am — which makes n_wde_trigger_weekly's own Sunday 3am schedule redundant (every Sunday would otherwise export twice). Ward confirmed disabling it (Aug 23 2026): n_wde_trigger_weekly is now set d:true (disabled in the editor, greyed out, won't fire) rather than deleted — left fully wired so it can just be re-enabled if Full Sync is ever turned off and this needs to cover on its own again. The manual trigger (n_wde_trigger_manual) is untouched and still works normally.

Retention (Ward, Aug 2026): every run (manual, weekly, or via Full Sync) now ends with a prune pass — keep every backup from the last 7 days, then the newest one per ISO week through the 30-day mark (~3 more), then the newest one per calendar month forever after that. See n_wde_prune_decide's own comment for the exact boundary logic. This runs on both the success AND failure path (n_wde_job_success/n_wde_job_failed both feed it) — pruning stale folders isn't contingent on today's export having worked.

Enumerates InfluxDB measurements DYNAMICALLY via Flux's `schema.measurements()` — not a hardcoded list — so newly-added measurements (this project's data model has been growing quickly) get picked up automatically without this flow needing an edit every time. For each measurement, runs a full-range Flux query and writes InfluxDB's own CSV response body directly to /share/wardstock_data_backup/<timestamp>/<measurement>.csv — no manual CSV conversion, InfluxDB's query API already returns annotated CSV natively (Content-Type: application/vnd.flux request, CSV response by default). Also writes a manifest.json (measurement list + row counts) for the Restore flow's verify mode to check against.

First place any of this project's flows queries InfluxDB (every other flow only ever writes to /api/v2/write) — genuinely new API surface, worth confirming the /api/v2/query request shape works as expected on first real run.

UNTESTED — built from InfluxDB v2's documented Flux/query API, never run against a live InfluxDB instance.

name: Weekly — Sunday 3am (DISABLED Aug 2026 — superseded by full_sync_flow.json's nightly 2am run, which calls this flow as its last step; left wired/intact in case Full Sync is ever disabled and this needs to cover on its own again)
Load secrets + start job log + backup dir
Warn on mkdir stderr (does not continue the pipeline)
Prepare start-point write
Build schema.measurements() Flux query
Parse measurement names from CSV response
Split: one message per measurement (manual fan-out, Aug 2026 split-node fix)
Build full-range Flux query for this measurement
Prepare CSV file write
Join: wait for all measurement writes
comment: Paired with n_wde_split_measurements via msg.parts (mode: auto).

name: Build + write manifest.json
Log success + update HA status
Prepare finish-point write
Catch any flow error (job_failed gap, Aug 2026)
comment: Fixes the gap flagged in PLAN.md §20's 'Known gap' note — this flow previously only handled its success path. Nothing in this flow has a native error output (all function/file/exec nodes here are single-output on their main path), so a catch node is what actually detects a real failure (a bad Flux query, disk write error, malformed InfluxDB CSV response). Scope null = catches any node on this tab.

name: Log failure + update HA status
SQLite: ensure job_status table exists
sqlite: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS
SQLite: prep status UPSERT
Decide which backup folders to prune (GFS retention)
Warn on prune stderr
func:
if (msg.payload) node.warn('backup prune stderr (a folder may not have been deleted): ' + msg.payload);
return null;
